Annotation grows up: graded judgments, readable pairs, measurable agreement.

- **Six-level semantic-equivalence scale** (scheme: Dr. Elena Pelican) replaces binary
  same/different — same rule / same advice / same theme / related / unrelated /
  contradictory — with her operational tests as the in-app judging guide. Mobile flow:
  swipe left = unrelated, swipe right = related → pick the relation.
- **English glosses everywhere**: annotators never see a pair they can't read (60.9% of
  the corpus is annotatable; originals shown beneath their gloss).
- **Krippendorff's α** (ordinal) in Diagnostics once pairs collect multiple votes.
- Raw scores are preserved; clustering constraints derive from them (≥3 must, ≤1 cannot).
